lines.text: Ugly rumors windborn tell of pissings
Surfing high on pissed off prayers
fears and couldn't have asked for
more Endless summers and teenage lust
There was no target we could miss
this Wise men ponder still fix
The only place I found myself was
poised for flight in men's room stall drenched in
alcohol sunshine came peeking through there wasn't
Cut our wrists on gilded sins and close the door back in
not nice but we saw through all their lies
